source: Actual local Scrum Poker UI captured with headless Playwright at a 1440 × 900 viewport at 2x device pixel ratio and encoded as lossless WebP.
content: Entirely synthetic checkout refinement session: Maya Chen facilitates Alex Rivera, Sam Taylor, and Jordan Lee. The first story shows an agreed estimate of 3; on the second story Maya has selected 5 in the private estimate deck, Alex and Sam have voted while Jordan is still waiting, and Reveal shows 3/4 voted. The deck legend is the one-line key-cap legend, Invite team is secondary because teammates have joined, and the saved-estimate banner is no longer shown after voting begins.
capture: Recaptured 2026-11-06. Room created, first estimate saved and Maya's vote cast through the application UI; documented HTTP API used to join synthetic teammates and submit their votes, with authenticated event streams maintaining live presence. The pointer was moved away from the cards and transitions were allowed to settle. No interface text or layout was altered for the capture; no real personal data or capability tokens are shown.
